settings.vibrance-value-desc: Digital vibrance intensity (0 = default, 1023 = maximum saturation)
settings.display-index-desc: 0 = all ports (recommended). Otherwise the nvibrant port to use, 1 = first. Run 'nvibrant' to see which port says 'Success'

toast.no-nvidia-title: NVibrant: no display to apply to
toast.failed-desc: nvibrant returned an error. Check the display port index in plugin settings.
toast.no-ctm-desc: The laptop panel needs niri with the color-matrix output action (niri PR #4543). Install the niri-ctm package and restart the session.
